description: This file implements scheduled post processing in Mattermost, including fetching pending scheduled posts, posting them, handling success/failure, and user notifications.

methods.name: ProcessScheduledPosts
methods.description: Main loop to process pending scheduled posts, fetches posts, processes each batch, and updates old posts.

methods.name: processScheduledPostBatch
methods.description: Processes a batch of scheduled posts, handling success and failures.

methods.name: postScheduledPost
methods.description: Processes an individual scheduled post, including permission checks and posting.

methods.name: canPostScheduledPost
methods.description: Checks whether a scheduled post can be posted based on permissions, channel status, and other constraints.

methods.name: handleSuccessfulScheduledPosts
methods.description: Deletes successfully posted scheduled posts from storage.

methods.name: handleFailedScheduledPosts
methods.description: Updates failed scheduled posts and notifies users.

methods.name: notifyUserAboutFailedScheduledMessages
methods.description: Sends notification messages to users about failed scheduled posts.

methods.name: aggregateFailMessagesByUser
methods.description: Aggregates failed messages by user for notification batching.

methods.name: notifyUser
methods.description: Creates a direct message to notify a user about failed scheduled posts, including detailed error reasons.

methods.name: getErrorReason
methods.description: Returns localized error reason string based on error code.
